results.title: Arthakencana Rayatama Buys Transaction of AKR Corporindo
results.body: On January 10, 2025, Arthakencana Rayatama, an insider, purchased 282,500 shares of AKR Corporindo increasing their holding from 12,768,961,300 to 12,770,472,000 shares. The transaction type was a "buy" with a total amount of 1,510,700. The purpose of the transaction was for investment. This insider trading activity may indicate confidence in the company's prospects, potentially influencing market sentiment and stock price.

results.title: Nery Polim Buy Transaction of AKR Corporindo
results.body: On January 10, 2025, Nery Polim, an insider, purchased 630,000 shares of AKR Corporindo increasing their holding from 1,050,000 to 1,680,000 shares. The transaction type was a "buy" with a price of IDR 1,045 per share. The purpose of the transaction was for investment. This transaction indicates a significant increase in Nery Polim's ownership stake in the company, potentially signaling confidence in the company's future performance.
